summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the new OPTIONAL biometric-unlock layer on the Kotiz Expo web preview. All 4 requested cases pass: (1) admin ASCB login (+2250708510832 / admin123) still works with no regression and lands on the tab content (Accueil dashboard) with NO biometric-lock overlay; (2) Paramètres > 'Sécurité' section is present with testID='security-section' and exposes the 'Déverrouillage biométrique' row + Switch testID='biometric-toggle'; (3) on web the toggle is inert (no state change on tap) and the hint 'Non disponible sur cet appareil' is displayed, no lock overlay ever appears; (4) no JS errors related to expo-local-authentication in the console — app boots, tabs navigate, reload with an active session does not trigger any lock screen. Real biometric flow (activation + lock at launch + password fallback) cannot be validated in the web preview per the task note; requires native build.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/biometrics.js correctly early-returns false on Platform.OS==='web' so expo-local-authentication is never called in the web bundle — good.
AuthContext.loadUser gates isLocked=true behind (bioPref && bioSupported && !isWeb), guaranteeing no lock overlay on web preview — good.
parametres.js disables the Switch when !biometricSupported and shows the 'Non disponible sur cet appareil' hint — good.
Minor: parametres.js file is 2413 lines; consider splitting into focused sub-modules (profile section, security section, admin section) for maintainability (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded admin ASCB (+2250708510832 / admin123).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real biometric activation + lock-at-launch + password fallback cannot be exercised on the Expo web preview (expo-local-authentication returns false on web). Only native build / physical device with enrolled biometrics can validate those paths. The web preview correctly renders the Sécurité section with a disabled Switch and the 'Non disponible sur cet appareil' hint, and never mounts BiometricLock. Login flow uses ASCB pre-selected + phone +2250708510832 + admin123. Backend under supervisor is 'kotiz-backend' on 8001; ignore the template 'backend' program.
